environment.data: isolated app sandbox; synthetic UI tasks only

scope.actual: narrow/large font navigation and scroll; inbox/active Focus entry
keyboard, estimate/title fields, saved Preview Back, explicit next draft, missing estimate inbox
scope.static: post-save Preview failure preserves savedTaskId and facts

scope.actual: large font keyboard; zero estimate rejected; controlled recovery; no persisted changes
scope.static: remaining versus estimated effort and read-only actual effort

scope.actual: future-day block, accessible fine adjustment and Preview rejected without writes
scope.static: PanResponder move/resize guards and protected blocks; timeline adjustment unit tests

scope.actual: commit confirmation, reject/back and before/after labels at large font
scope.static: previewId and versioned Application commit boundary

scope.actual: pause, cold App restart, identical native paused facts, resume and explicit complete
scope.static: disabled/busy, mindful transition once, explicit completion controls

scope.actual: unique completion link, visible source caption and detail; large-font scroll
scope.static: completion evidence remains source; user notes do not rewrite facts

scope.actual: large-font permission controls, local-only configuration, scroll and save
scope.static: roles and checkbox checked state; foreground-only permission requests

scope.actual: recover existing active record, readable dark content and scrollable end action, explicit end
scope.static: productive recovery copy, never creates Task CompletionRecord

findings.trigger: 320dp Android three-button navigation; tab hit target overlapped OS Home
findings.change: tab height and bottom padding include useSafeAreaInsets
findings.retest: Capture navigation and subsequent actual journeys remain in the app

findings.trigger: save task to Preview, then Android Back leaves saved form read-only without a next-draft action
findings.change: explicit next task action resets only draft state; preserves saved Task
findings.retest: four existing task facts preserved; two synthetic tasks added; plan/block facts unchanged; next missing-estimate task reached inbox

findings.trigger: active Relax persisted but its body was blank on the device
findings.change: native SafeAreaView style for required layout/background; active Relax uses scrollable controls
findings.retest: same active Relax record recovered and ended at font scale 1.3; no fabricated task completion

findings.trigger: source review found unlabeled roles and short permission action targets
findings.change: Task/Settings action roles, calendar checkbox state, permission minimum height
findings.retest: actual hierarchy and permission-action screenshot; no screen-reader completion claim

findings.trigger: light pages displayed white status icons after dark session screens
findings.change: light-page dark status bar; Focus/active focused Relax light status bar
findings.retest: completed Win and Achievement detail screenshots show dark icons on light background

limitations: bounded audit, not exhaustive accessibility certification
native drag/resize gestures reviewed in source and unit tests, not executed by this audit
VoiceOver/TalkBack and physical iOS/Android were not exercised
iOS full usability journey not claimed
Settings real OS provider projection, calendar account and notification delivery remain separate external gates
